subject: Draft MAP + ops slate for Helix evaluation
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Draft MAP + ops slate for Helix evaluation

Hi Alicia + Tom —

Thanks again for the time this week. Per our call, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) starter doc and a compact 30-day sprint slate so we can align on scope, acceptance criteria, and the close timeline. The goal is a tight technical evaluation with clear success gates so your team can validate latency/cost for the NER and triage pipelines.

What I shared:
- Helix_MAP_Starter_v0.9.gdoc (link below) — MAP sections: objective, stakeholders, success criteria, week-by-week milestones.
- 30d-sprint-timeline-v2.gslides — a one-slide timeline + owners.

Asks / next steps:
1) Would you and Tom take a quick pass on the doc and add any missing stakeholders or constraints? I left open slots for SOC/compliance asks and data samples.
2) Pick one of these kickoff windows: Sep 21–23 (preferred) or Sep 28–30. We can run a 90m workshop (tech + ops) and then a 2-week integration sprint.
3) If you want, Marissa will add a short runbook for the inference tests we plan to run (latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, throughput).

Google Doc (seed): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-HELIX-MAP-SEED
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HLX-2026-1142

I attached the gdoc/gslides as stubs for your review.

Brief signature —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Helix_MAP_Starter_v0.9.gdoc (Google Doc link), 30d-sprint-timeline-v2.gslides (slides link)

From: Alicia Park <alicia@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Russo <tom.russo@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 11:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + ops slate for Helix evaluation

Thanks Grace — this looks like a great starting point. A few quick notes:

- We like the objective framing. Please add a short glossary for the NER model variants so our clinical teams can follow.
- Can you call out the data slice we plan to run (ED triage logs vs. retrospective notes)? We want to validate both.
- SOC2 evidence: our procurement team will need a quick readme of where logs/audit trails live and retention windows. Can you attach a short summary?

We are tentatively ok for Sep 21 (prefer afternoon PST) for the kickoff workshop. Tom and I will review the doc and add merged comments by EOD Sep 14. I attached our procurement questionnaire (short).

Alicia Park
Director, Clinical Data Engineering — Helix Health
alicia@helixhealth.com

Attachments: Helix_Procurement_Q_short.xlsx (procurement form)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <alicia@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 08:45 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + ops slate for Helix evaluation

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM Alicia Park <alicia@helixhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Grace — this looks like a great starting point. A few quick notes:
> 
> - We like the objective framing. Please add a short glossary for the NER model variants so our clinical teams can follow.
> - Can you call out the data slice we plan to run (ED triage logs vs. retrospective notes)? We want to validate both.
> - SOC2 evidence: our procurement team will need a quick readme of where logs/audit trails live and retention windows. Can you attach a short summary?

Thanks for the prompt feedback, Alicia — I added a short glossary section (NER model names + quantization tiers) and a proposed data-slice matrix in the MAP doc. I also attached a brief SOC2-readme (SOC2-Evidence-README.pdf) that calls out audit logs, retention defaults, and how we surface traces in the console.

Updates I made in the doc:
- "Acceptance" section: added P95 latency targets and cost-per-1k-token evaluation buckets.
- "Week 0" workshop agenda: added a data-handling checklist and a short run of the inference smoke test.
- Condensed timeline option B (if you want a lighter validate-only sprint) — moved to an appendix slide in the slides file.

I also created a short one-slide summary for the execs so you can share it internally: 30d-sprint-timeline-v2.gslides (attached).

Proposed workshop windows (all PST):
• Tue Sep 21, 1:30–3:00p
• Wed Sep 22, 10:00–11:30a

If either works for you, we can send a calendar invite and make sure engineering + platform are there.

—Marissa
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-Evidence-README.pdf, 30d-sprint-timeline-v2.gslides (slide deck)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@helixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15 04:40 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + ops slate for Helix evaluation

Great — thanks everyone. Quick summary and agreed next steps so this thread is the single source of truth: 

Agreed kickoff: Tue Sep 21, 1:30–3:00p PST — 90m workshop (tech + ops)
Owners: Helix — Alicia (clinical/ops), Tom (infra) | Redwood — Grace (AM), Marissa (CS), Jordan (Solutions Eng)
Primary goals:
- Validate NER variants on the ED triage slice (functional acceptance)
- Measure P95 latency and cost per 1k tokens on a 10k request sample
- Confirm retention/audit behavior for the inference logs (SOC2 readout)

Action items:
1) Alicia/Tom: add stakeholders and any compliance constraints to the MAP doc (by EOD Sep 14) — Alicia confirmed this will be done.
2) Marissa: finalize SOC2-Evidence-README.pdf and upload to the shared doc (done).
3) Jordan: prepare the smoke-test harness and a script to reproduce the latency test (will attach prior to workshop).
4) Grace: send meeting invite and master MAP link + prework checklist.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-HELIX-MAP-SEED (master)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HLX-2026-1142

I'll send the calendar invite now and include a short prework checklist for Helix engineers. If anything changes, reply-all so we keep everyone aligned.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: Helix_MAP_Starter_v0.9.gdoc, 30d-sprint-timeline-v2.gslides, SOC2-Evidence-README.pdf
